subject: Re: Redwood pricing - token volumes & budget owner
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.j@acme-ai.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme-ai.com>
Cc: priyom.das@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 15:05:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap + ask: token volumes, budget owner, target $/1M tokens

Thanks again for the time today - great conversation. Quick recap from my side and a couple asks so we can put together a tight pricing/commit proposal: 

Call recap
- Use case: ACME portal & API summarization + search reranking for customer support.
- Expected ramp: pilot (month 1-3) ~50-100M tokens, steady-state months 4+ ~150-250M tokens/month.
- Latency target: 150-300ms p50 for generation routes; embeddings for search are lower qps.

Pricing asks / next steps
1) Can you confirm the primary budget owner / economic buyer for this initiative? (who signs off on 6-12mo committed spend)
2) Finance sign-off cadence - is there a monthly PO process or quarterly review?
3) For modeling, can you confirm the monthly token target range you want us to base the committed pricing on (we used 200M tokens/mo as the example in the estimate attached)?
4) Target unit economics: would a target price band of $700-900 per 1M tokens meet your goals, or do you need to be below $700/1M?

Attached: redwood-pricing-estimate.pdf (high-level commit tiers and example TCO for 150/200/250M tokens).

If you can reply with the budget owner and the target $/1M tokens you want us to aim for, I'll draft a committed pricing proposal and map to the appropriate SLA/commit term.

Thanks -
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0128
Redwood Inference

From: Alex Johnson <alex.j@acme-ai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme-ai.com>, finance@acme-ai.com
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 09:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + ask: token volumes, budget owner, target $/1M tokens

Hi Marissa - thanks for the recap and for the estimate. Confirming details from our side: 

- Monthly volume: we expect pilot months to be ~60-90M, and production steady-state to be in the 150-250M tokens/month range. Planning model center at 200M tokens/mo.
- Budget range: team has allocated roughly $120k-200k/mo for this initiative depending on committed pricing and SLA.
- Economic buyer / budget owner: Priya Shah (CFO) is the person who will sign the commercial terms for platform spend - I've cc'd her and finance.
- Finance cadence: our finance team prefers a PO + monthly invoice; for larger committed deals they will request an annual commitment with monthly invoicing.

Regarding unit economics, we were hoping to be in the <= $800 per 1M tokens band if possible. If you can show a committed tier that gets us to $700-800/1M for 200M tokens with a 12-month commit, that would land well in our internal model.

Happy to jump on a quick call with Priya if that helps speed approvals.

Thanks,
Alex Johnson
Head of Product - Search & Assist
Acme AI
alex.j@acme-ai.com | (617) 555-0442

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Post-call recap + ask: token volumes, budget owner, target $/1M tokens

FYI - Acme (Alex) confirmed 150-250M/mo (centering at 200M) and Priya (CFO) is the economic buyer. They want to be <= $800/1M ideally; comfortable if we can get to $700-800/1M on a 12mo commit.

Can we model a committed offer that hits $700/1M at 200M tokens with standard SLA (99.9%) and monthly invoices? Attached is the pricing model I used.

Key asks: 
- Is $700/1M something we can approve within quota/discount constraints for a 12-month committed deal at 200M tokens?
- If not, what would be the closest approved tier we can offer and what concessions (min ARR, billing cadence, commitment length) do we need to get there?

Forwarded message included below.

-
Marissa

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Post-call recap + ask: token volumes, budget owner, target $/1M tokens

Thanks for the context. Approve offering a committed tier at $700 per 1M tokens for 200M tokens/month on a 12-month commitment, subject to standard SOC2 + SLA language and monthly invoicing.

Notes: this will require a minimum ARR of $1.68M (200M * 700 * 12 / 1e6) and we should flag for RevOps to create the PO template. Priyom - can you confirm RevOps will process monthly invoices under that structure and queue any needed legal redlines?

Marissa - please proceed to present the committed proposal to Priya (CFO) and include the attached estimate and the proposed pricing tier. If Priya needs a finance-facing one-pager, I can draft the short note.

- Aditya
Head of Sales, US
aditya.rao@redwood.ai
